questions.question: What is the best description of a variable in Thunkable?
answers: A container that stores a piece of information like a number or text
A block that connects two screens
A setting that controls the app's appearance

questions.question: Which of the following can a variable store?
answers: Information such as numbers or text

questions.question: If you set a variable to the value 10 and then set it to 25, what value does the variable hold?
Which of the following is NOT a type of variable in Thunkable?
Why are variables useful in a Thunkable app?
answers: They make the app download faster
They let the app work with data, enabling features like tracking user interactions
They add animations to the screen

questions.question: Where does an App variable store its data?
answers: On the device's hard drive permanently
In the app's memory during the current session

questions.question: A user is playing a game and has a score of 50 stored in an App variable. They close and reopen the app. What is the score now?
answers: 0 or whatever the initial value was — the data is reset
The app will crash because the data was lost

questions.question: Which variable type is the one you will use most often in Thunkable?
Which of the following is a good use case for an App variable?
answers: Saving a user's theme preference so it loads next time
Tracking which page of a slideshow the user is currently viewing
Syncing a shopping list across a phone and a tablet
Storing a username so the user stays logged in after closing the app

questions.question: What makes Stored variables different from App variables?
answers: Stored variables can only hold numbers
Stored variables save data on the device between app sessions
Stored variables are shared across multiple devices
Stored variables are deleted when the app is closed

questions.question: A fitness app needs to remember a user's daily step goal so it is still set the next time they open the app on the same phone. Which variable type should be used?
Which of the following is NOT a good use case for a Stored variable?
answers: Remembering a "dark mode" setting between sessions
Sharing a document with users on other devices
Keeping a user logged in after restarting the app

questions.question: Where does a Cloud variable store its data?
answers: In the cloud, accessible from multiple devices
In a local file on the phone

questions.question: What is the main advantage of a Cloud variable compared to the other variable types?
answers: It is faster than other variables
Its data can be accessed from multiple devices and by multiple users

questions.question: A team collaboration app allows multiple users to edit a shared task list from different phones. Which variable type should store the task list?
Which of the following is a good example of using a Cloud variable?
answers: Counting how many times a button is tapped in one session
Saving a user's nickname on their own device
A live chat feature where messages appear on all users' devices
Storing the current screen the user is viewing

questions.question: A student is building a timer app. The timer counts down from 60 seconds during one session and does not need to be saved. Which variable type is best?
A developer wants to save a user's favorite recipes so they are still available after the app is closed, but only on the same device. Which variable type should they use?
A classroom polling app needs to collect and display live votes from 30 students on different devices in real time. Which variable type is best?
Which of the following statements about Thunkable variables is FALSE?
answers: Cloud variables allow data to be accessed from multiple devices
Stored variables save data on the device between sessions
App variables persist their data after the app is closed and reopened
A variable can hold only one value at a time
